evaluation: Frozen M2 episode and parameter-group split; known attributes; recorded candidate actions. All overlapping windows retained, including failures and load spikes. No future measured state in rollout. This reused test set informed M2.1 design; comparisons are continuity/regression evidence.

baselines.pure_prior: Zero learned garment torque, human implicit impedance integration, cuff action translation; wrist load held
baselines.mean_properties: Only K/D/friction replaced by training means; q_ref retained

units: Loads are net estimated wrist external load in N/Nm, not isolated human contact or measured F/T. Predicted human garment torque is equivalent generalized action without direct labels.
aggregation: Pooled component RMSE over anchor windows; episode/group scores retained. Overlapping windows are not independent trials.
anchor_phase_note: Stride 4 reproduces M2 exactly but a one-frame load spike appears only at certain endpoint phases; horizon sawtooth is sampling phase, not periodic predicted load. Stride 1 supplementary results sample all endpoint phases. Neither evaluation removes peaks.
